# BRO test fixtures

Geotechnical borehole research (BHR-GT) from the Dutch Key Register of the Subsurface (BRO, Basisregistratie
Ondergrond), kept byte for byte as the BRO web service returns them
(`https://publiek.broservices.nl/sr/bhrgt/v2/objects/<BRO-ID>`):

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `BHR000000361914.xml` | Maasvlakte 2, Rotterdam: field description and groundwater level, no laboratory tests |
| `BHR000000470183.xml` | Maasvlakte 2, Rotterdam, harbour basin: field and laboratory descriptions and laboratory tests |

Source: BRO, Basisregistratie Ondergrond. BRO data are open data in the public domain (CC0 1.0); no rights are claimed
on them here.
